halftone.label: Halftone
halftone.desc: Separate color channels into angled halftone screens and overprint inks on warm paper, from newsprint to CMY and two-color prints.
halftone.cellSizeDesc: Controls the halftone grid cell size. Larger values produce sparser dots
halftone.dotScaleDesc: Dot size relative to the cell
halftone.angleDesc: Overall rotation angle of the grid

diffusion.label: Diffusion
diffusion.desc: Error diffusion dithering effect, simulating color spreading and quantization in traditional printing for unique textural quality.
diffusion.levelsDesc: Color quantization levels. Lower values produce fewer colors and stronger effects

popart.label: Pop Art
popart.desc: Pop art style with high saturation, high contrast, and posterization for bold, vibrant visuals.
popart.levelsDesc: Posterization levels. Lower values produce fewer tones and flatter effects

lightshadow.label: Light & Shadow
lightshadow.desc: Dramatic tonal shaping with deeper shadows, thresholded highlight glow, and a subtle screen-space ambient gradient.
lightshadow.contrastDesc: Contrast between light and dark areas
lightshadow.thresholdDesc: Brightness threshold for light-dark separation. Below = shadow
lightshadow.lightDirDesc: Direction of the screen-space ambient gradient. 0°=right, 90°=up, 180°=left, 270°=down

sketch.label: Sketch
sketch.desc: Sketch style, extracting outlines through multi-direction edge detection with optional hatching, simulating hand-drawn pencil sketches.
sketch.sensitivityDesc: Edge detection sensitivity. Lower values detect more edges
sketch.bgColorDesc: Paper background color (was a white/navy toggle, now a free color picker)

pointillism.label: Pointillism
pointillism.desc: Pointillism style, reconstructing images with dense colored dots, paying homage to Impressionist painters like Seurat.
pointillism.dotSizeDesc: Brush scale for each color mark
pointillism.densityDesc: Mark occupancy, with more marks in dark or colorful areas
pointillism.sizeVariationDesc: Random variation amplitude of dot sizes

kaleidoscope.label: Kaleidoscope
kaleidoscope.desc: Mirrors cut the photo into a diamond tessellation with three imaging modes: tube (every facet repeats one mirrored window), positional, and mirror reflection (each facet reflects a different photo region at its own angle). Rotate the tube, not the photo; facet content shifts with the reflection angle. Great for symmetrical collages, mandala portraits, and stained-glass visuals.
kaleidoscope.segmentsDesc: Number of mirror sectors (a real kaleidoscope uses 6)
kaleidoscope.mirrorModeDesc: How facets image the photo: tube repeats one window; the other modes reflect a different photo region per facet angle
kaleidoscope.fractureDesc: Shatter each base diamond into finer diamonds; every sector fractures identically
kaleidoscope.cellSizeDesc: Size of the base diamond (tessellation density)
kaleidoscope.rotationDesc: Rotate the mirror assembly itself while the photo stays fixed; facet content shifts with the reflection angle
kaleidoscope.zoomDesc: Framing zoom of the photo in front of the tube
kaleidoscope.centerXDesc: Horizontal position of the photo in front of the tube
kaleidoscope.centerYDesc: Vertical position of the photo in front of the tube
kaleidoscope.prismDesc: Enable the prismatic mirror coloring; disable for faithful photo-color mirrors
kaleidoscope.viewMaskDesc: Fill the whole frame with diamonds or limit them to a circular eyepiece view

crosshatch.label: Crosshatch
crosshatch.desc: Screen-tone draft style, black & white line art + rotatable screen dots + paper noise, simulating comic screen-tone printing texture.
crosshatch.invertDesc: Invert line and background (white on black)

animelight.label: Anime Light
animelight.desc: Anime lighting style with high-saturation ambient light, outlines, and god rays for Japanese animation-style visuals.
animelight.godRayLengthDesc: How far beams extend from the light source
animelight.godRayThresholdDesc: How bright a region must be to cast beams
animelight.godRayAutoDesc: Light source follows the brightest region; dragging the source turns this off

textraster.label: Text Raster
textraster.desc: Text raster style, reconstructing images as text grids where each cell maps brightness through character density. Great for text posters, info screens, and experimental typography.
textraster.cellSizeDesc: Pixel size of each character cell
textraster.fontSizeDesc: Font size in the text texture

ascii.label: ASCII Art
ascii.desc: Convert an image into ASCII character art using a custom character set, with adjustable density, color and background filtering.
ascii.charsetDesc: Any mix of CJK, letters, digits and symbols. Characters are sorted by ink density automatically.
ascii.fontDesc: Upload TTF / WOFF / OTF. Falls back to monospace if none.
ascii.showBgDesc: Overlay the original image beneath the characters.
ascii.charScaleDesc: Character size relative to its cell.
ascii.cellSizeDesc: Cell size in pixels — smaller means denser characters.
ascii.randomScaleDesc: Random per-character scaling for depth. 0 disables.
ascii.bgFilterDesc: Skip flat low-contrast regions; higher skips more.

none.label: Normal
none.desc: Display the original 3D model without any particle effects

surface.label: Surface Particles
surface.desc: Particles rest on the model surface, basic particle visualization

explosion.label: Explosion
explosion.desc: Particles scatter from the model surface and return

morph.label: Morph
morph.desc: Smooth shape transition between two models

vortex.label: Vortex
vortex.desc: Particles orbit around the model forming a vortex

density.label: Density
density.desc: Particles fill the model volume, showing density variation

about.title: About
about.description: PixelForge is a web-based real-time image artistic style transfer tool powered by WebGL shaders. It offers both 2D image stylization and 3D particle animation capabilities — all image processing happens locally in your browser, and your files are never uploaded.
about.feature2d: 2D Image Stylization — 10 artistic effects including Halftone, Diffusion, Pop Art, Light & Shadow, Sketch, Pointillism, Kaleidoscope, Crosshatch, Anime Light, and Text Raster.
about.feature3d: 3D Particle Animation — Transform GLTF models into particle effects with Explosion, Morph, Vortex, and Density simulations.
about.techStack: Built with React 19, TypeScript, Three.js, WebGL shaders, and Vite.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.collectBody: All PixelForge image processing happens in your browser: images and models you upload are processed locally using WebGL and never leave your device. This site requires no account and collects no personal identity information such as names, email addresses, or phone numbers. Only the redemption-code membership service sends data to our server (see the next section).
privacy.licenseBody: When activating, extending, or syncing a membership, this site sends to its own server: the redemption code you enter, and a random device identifier (UUID) automatically generated by your browser. The identifier is used solely for device binding and is not linked to any personal information. The server records redemption status and device bindings for membership verification and duplicate-use prevention; like any regular website, it also keeps access logs (such as IP address and access time) solely for abuse prevention. This data is used for no other purpose and is never sold or shared with third parties.
privacy.usageBody: Since image processing happens locally, this site does not use any personal image data. Data involved in the redemption-code service is used only for membership verification, device binding, and abuse prevention.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use essential local storage to remember your language preference, parameter settings, and membership credential. No tracking cookies are used.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: This site integrates no third-party analytics, advertising, or data collection services. If you purchase a redemption code through a third-party channel, that channel's own privacy policy applies to the information it collects.
privacy.securityBody: All image processing happens locally in your browser using WebGL. Your files are never uploaded to any server.
privacy.rightsBody: Your uploaded images and models are never uploaded anywhere, so there is no server-side data to access or delete. To request deletion of membership-related data (redemption records, device bindings), contact us at oychi.oylz@gmail.com.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
privacy.contactBody: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at oychi.oylz@gmail.com

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.acceptanceBody: By accessing and using PixelForge, you accept and agree to be bound by these terms and conditions.
terms.licenseBody: Permission is granted to use PixelForge for personal and commercial purposes. This license does not include the right to modify, distribute, or sublicense the software.
terms.membershipBody: Membership is activated with redemption codes and is a digitally delivered good; delivery of the code constitutes receipt of the product. This service is not covered by 7-day no-questions-asked returns. Unused (not yet activated) redemption codes may be refunded via the purchase channel; whether a code has been activated is determined by our server's redemption records. Activated codes (including codes consumed as renewal packs) are considered used and are non-refundable and non-exchangeable.
terms.deviceBody: Each membership can be bound to at most 5 devices (including the first device used for activation). Switching browsers, clearing browser data, or reinstalling the operating system consumes a new binding slot; once slots are exhausted, additional slots can only be obtained through renewal (each renewal grants +1 slot). The redemption code is the sole proof of membership: this site has no account system, and lost codes cannot be reissued, frozen, or recovered — please store them safely. The membership validity period is the expiry time shown at activation or renewal; after expiry the account automatically reverts to the free tier, and previously exported files are unaffected. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate the membership service of any code in cases of abuse (including but not limited to sharing or reselling codes, and fraudulent redemption).
terms.userContentBody: You retain all rights to images and models you upload. PixelForge processes your content locally and does not store or transmit it.
terms.limitationsBody: PixelForge is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.
terms.disclaimerBody: The software is provided for creative and educational purposes. The developers shall not be held liable for any damages arising from the use of this software.
terms.governingLawBody: These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with applicable local laws.
terms.changesBody: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting.
terms.contactBody: For questions about these terms, please contact oychi.oylz@gmail.com

help.title: Help
help.style2dSteps:
1. Click "2D Image Stylization" on the home page
2. Upload an image by dragging or clicking the upload area
3. Select an artistic style from the left panel
4. Adjust effect parameters using the sliders
5. Click the download button to save your result
help.style3dSteps:
1. Click "3D Particle Animation" on the home page
2. Upload a GLTF or GLB model file
3. Choose a particle effect from the effect panel
4. Adjust particle parameters (size, color, speed, etc.)
5. Use the capture panel to take screenshots or record video
help.tipsBrowser: Best viewed in Chrome, Edge, or Firefox with hardware acceleration enabled.
help.tipsFormats: 2D mode supports JPG, PNG, and WebP images. 3D mode supports GLTF and GLB model files.
help.tipsPerformance: Large images or complex models may affect performance. Try reducing image resolution or model complexity if you experience lag.
help.memberBody: The free tier includes 5 watermark-free single-image exports per day (based on your browser's local date), with all effects and parameters available. Beyond that, exports carry a watermark (corner watermark on single images, tiled watermark on batch exports); no other features are affected. With an active membership, all exports are watermark-free.

licenseHelp.title: Redemption Codes & Membership
licenseHelp.freeBody: 5 watermark-free single-image exports per day (based on your browser's local date, reset daily), with all effects and parameters available. Beyond the quota, single-image exports carry a corner watermark and batch exports carry a tiled watermark; no other features are affected.
licenseHelp.memberBody: All exports are watermark-free while your membership is active. Membership is activated with a redemption code — no account needed, and image processing always stays local.
licenseHelp.activateBody: Open the "2D Image Stylization" page, click the "Membership" button in the top-right corner to open the panel, paste your redemption code, and click "Activate". After activation, save the code immediately (screenshot or write it down): after switching devices or browsers, or clearing browser data, you will need to re-enter the code to restore your membership.
licenseHelp.renewBody: While your membership is active, paste a new redemption code in the panel and click "Extend" — the validity period extends from the current expiry time, and the number of bindable devices increases by 1. If the same membership has been activated on another device, click "Sync latest expiry" to refresh the local expiry time without re-entering a code.
licenseHelp.device1: Each membership can be bound to at most 5 devices; the first activation counts
licenseHelp.device2: Switching browsers, clearing browser data, or reinstalling the OS consumes a new binding slot
licenseHelp.device3: Once slots are exhausted, renewal grants +1 additional slot
licenseHelp.device4: New device: enter the original redemption code on the new device to activate (requires a remaining slot)
licenseHelp.hintFormat: The copy was incomplete or extra characters crept in — copy the entire code from start to end
licenseHelp.hintSignature: The code was not issued by this site or has been altered; contact the seller to verify
licenseHelp.hintExpired: The membership has expired; a new redemption code is required to activate again
licenseHelp.hintUsed: Each redemption code can be consumed only once — this one has already been used (e.g., as a renewal pack); use a new code
licenseHelp.hintIdentityConflict: An identity code belongs to another membership and cannot be used as a renewal pack; renew with a fresh, unused code
licenseHelp.hintDeviceExhausted: This membership's device slots are exhausted; renewal grants +1 additional slot
licenseHelp.hintNetwork: Activating, extending and syncing require internet; everyday use and membership checks do not
licenseHelp.hintRateLimit: Too many attempts in a short time — wait a moment and try again
licenseHelp.tip1: The redemption code is the sole proof of membership: this site has no account system, and lost codes cannot be reissued or recovered — store them safely
licenseHelp.tip2: Clearing browser data also clears your membership credential; restoring it requires re-entering the code and consumes one device slot
licenseHelp.tip3: Activate on a device you use regularly, to avoid consuming binding slots on temporary devices
